run_body_mocap_demo: run the body mocap demo on a video or webcam input with 3D mesh visualization
run_body_mocap_on_video: run body mocap regression on video frames to extract 3D body mesh predictions
run_body_mocap_on_webcam: run body mocap in real time from a webcam feed with live mesh rendering
run_body_mocap_with_precomputed_bboxes: run body mocap using pre-computed bounding boxes from a JSON directory input
run_body_mocap_single_person: run body mocap in single person mode to track only the largest detected body
